crossRefs.note: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet king…

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Bahurim
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Shimei, who cursed David.

translations.web: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly, and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.
translations.bsb: But a young man did see them and told Absalom. So the two left quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
translations.asv: But a lad saw them, and told Absalom: and they went both of them away quickly, and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down thither.
